controlled_shift_simulation.injected_change: traffic_volume multiplied by 1.5 in the recent sample

interpretation: PASS/Normal means no monitored feature crossed the configured PSI threshold; ALERT/Requires investigation means at least one feature distribution changed materially.
limitations: PSI detects distribution change, not predictive error or operational impact.
The threshold is a heuristic; alerts require human investigation and may reflect seasonality.
The injected 50% traffic shift is a controlled test, not an observed event.
